title: DCCP: Added option to show relative sequence numbers
description:
DCCP: Added option to show relative sequence numbers.

DCCP sequence numbers (and acknowledgements) are usually 48-bit numbers. To make usage easier, this MR adds an option to display relative sequence numbers, like it is also supported for TCP. By default, the new option is turned on, like for TCP.
